evidence_quote: This paper presents a flexible measuring system to identify energy efficiency potentials
the system can be improved regarding an automated reporting of energy performance indicators

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Tool/software design: the paper presents a flexible energy measuring system (four hardware/software modules including custom C# software) that acquires and visualises component-level machine energy data. No EnPI or EnB measurement model is constructed or characterised - no normalisation variables, functional form, or baseline/estimation approach - and EnPI reporting is named only as future work. Per the v2.3 rule, a tool/software paper without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content is ineligible.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the flexible measuring system was structured into 4 modules

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: energy-measurement tool paper in an explicit ISO 50001 context (reports component-level consumption, drive over-dimensioning, ~37% savings) but characterises no EnPI/EnB model - EnPIs named only as future work. Case study is discrete manufacturing, so level_3b is also false on the merits. Recommend human eligibility review.
